prior_summary: Diffuse body-frame SE(3) corrections and resolve each executed slot from the fresh measured TCP, using causal relational and robot-state features to reduce sensitivity to small intermediate-state tracking mismatch.
applicable_conditions: Prefer for partial-progress invocation or small TCP/configuration mismatch when drawer, handle relation, finger order and phase remain close to demonstrated support.
termination_guidance: Hand off after the drawer is near 0.300 m and stable, fingers are open, TCP is safely clear and moving toward/above the unchanged block.
limitations: Local corrections do not force large drawer or block displacement equivariance and do not recover missed contact. Large corrections may be unreachable or collide, and phase can remain ambiguous.

config.action_frame: fresh measured TCP body frame per executed slot
config.action_layout: body translation 3 + body rotation vector 3 + gripper 1
